content: {"summary":"Ledger‑service‑01 experienced intermittent NXDOMAIN errors from 06:30 to 07:45 UTC on 2025‑05‑02 because the zone‑file push to internal‑dns‑01 omitted the ledger database record, causing that DNS server to return a negative answer while internal‑dns‑02 returned the correct one.","likely_cause":"Missing ledger‑database DNS record in the zone file deployed to internal‑dns‑01 during the push.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The zone‑file push to internal‑dns‑01 omitted the ledger database record, leading to NXDOMAIN responses.","evidence_ids":["INC-0038#1","INC-0038#2"],"quote":"the file on internal-dns-01 lacked the ledger database record"},{"text":"Answers alternated between correct and incorrect, indicating one DNS server was returning bad data.","evidence_ids":["INC-0038#1"],"quote":"answers arrive alternately right and wrong"},{"text":"Query both DNS servers and compare their serial numbers or answers to identify the faulty server.","evidence_ids":["INC-0038#2"],"quote":"querying both servers for the same name and putting their serials side by side"}],"next_checks":["Run `dig @internal-dns-01 <ledger-db-name>.prod.internal` and `dig @internal-dns-02 <ledger-db-name>.prod.internal` and compare results","Check the zone file on internal-dns-01 for the presence of the ledger‑db record","Compare the SOA serial numbers of the zone on internal-dns-01 and internal-dns-02","Review the push logs to confirm which server received the updated zone file"]}
